name: Fyndia Papadopoulou
rel: Worked with Arifa on the same team
text: I had the opportunity and honour to work closely with Arifa, our HR and Office Manager. Throughout our collaboration, I witnessed her strong professionalism and commitment. In her HR role, she managed her responsibilities diligently, ensuring smooth handling of employee matters, supporting recruitment processes, and maintaining a positive and well-organized work environment.

Beyond her HR duties, Arifa was also a valuable support to the finance department. Whenever needed, she stepped in with a "can-do" mindset, approaching tasks with reliability and efficiency. Her proactive attitude and willingness to help made a real difference, particularly in cross-departmental collaboration.
Arifa's dedication, adaptability, and supportive nature have been highly appreciated. She has proven to be an integral part of the team and will be valuable to any future opportunity she pursues.…

name: AbduL Wajid
role: Senior Manager – Corporate Sales | Go-To-Market Strategy | Enterprise Relationships
rel: Arifa was his client (she attended his HR course)
text: I had the pleasure of having Ms Arifa as a participant in my HR course, and I was consistently impressed by her enthusiasm, professionalism, and strong commitment to learning. From the beginning, she demonstrated a genuine passion for human resources and a clear drive to grow in her field.

Throughout the course, she was highly engaged, asked thoughtful questions, and consistently applied the concepts with real-world insight. Her ability to grasp complex HR topics and relate them to practical scenarios made her stand out among her peers.

I have no doubt that Ms Arifa brings the same level of dedication and excellence to her role as an HR professional. She is truly an asset to any organization, and I'm confident she will continue to thrive and make a meaningful impact in the HR space.…
